name: Texture-Space Sampling
definition: A technique to form training batches by sampling unknowns uniformly directly in texture space, rather than sampling a random subset of views. This reduces noise in gradients by proceeding with batches of observations directly relevant to the selected unknowns.
summary: Texture-Space Sampling forms training batches by uniformly sampling texture variables directly in UV space, prioritizing latent representation uniformity over input data uniformity.
